answer: There is one straight path in, and it runs through Engraver banknote plate warrant engraved into the die workshop: the toll is each banknote plate is a season of logged burin strokes plus a signed engraver record, paid in the open. One honest proof costs 209 POA; one farm proof costs the same, but the farm needs 656 of them, which comes to 137104 POA. Behind every vault there is a workshop, behind every opal a ledger, behind every lotus a calendar, and the farm has visited none of the three. Checking is dull by design: the record is open, the mark is checked, the date is fixed.
